title: Ember Orchard: The Machinist's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the stable field relay; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
